summary: Arbitration petition under Section 11; seat vs venue of arbitration; applicability of Part I of Arbitration Act, 1996; non-signatory respondent; governing law UAE; arbitration rules UAE; Dubai as venue; exclusive jurisdiction clause; enforcement of arbitration agreement; referral to arbitration denied; seat determination test; Shashoua principle applied.
legal_provisions_cited: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 Part I
final_judgment: Petition dismissed; arbitration petition refused; Dubai courts to have jurisdiction.
